description_en: Deletes a global active database cluster
description_zh: 该接口用于删除RDS全球多活数据库集群
kebab_example: aliyun rds delete-gad-instance --gad-instance-name gad-rm-bp1npi2j80000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteGadInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the global active database cluster. You can call the GadInstanceName operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的RDS全球多活数据库集群ID。可调用DescribeGadInstances查询
parameters.name: gad_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the central node of the global active database cluster. The central node refers to the primary node. You can call the DescribeGadInstances operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 集群中心节点（主节点）所在的地域ID。可调用DescribeGadInstances查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口获取
parameters.name: resource_group_id
